command:
set -eu
root=/srv/legacy2/selective-tape-restore
archive=$root/tapes/friday.tar
printf '%s\n' '--- tar implementation ---'
tar --version | sed -n '1,2p'
printf '%s\n' '--- archive table of contents ---'
tar -tvf "$archive"
printf '%s\n' '--- requested archived metadata and digests ---'
while IFS= read -r path; do
  [ -n "$path" ] || continue
  case "$path" in /*|../*|*/../*|*/..|.) printf 'UNSAFE_REQUEST %s\n' "$path"; exit 2;; esac
  count=$(tar -tf "$archive" | awk -v wanted="$path" '$0==wanted {n++} END {print n+0}')
  printf 'request=%s exact_archive_entries=%s\n' "$path" "$count"
  [ "$count" -eq 1 ] || exit 3
  tar -xOf "$archive" "$path" | sha256sum
  tar -tvf "$archive" "$path"
done < "$root/restore-request.txt"
printf '%s\n' '--- live pre-restore inventory and customer fingerprint ---'
find "$root/live" -mindepth 1 -printf '%M %u:%g %s %P\n' | sort
stat -c 'customers mode=%a uid=%u gid=%g size=%s inode=%i mtime=%Y' "$root/live/customers.csv"
sha256sum "$root/live/customers.csv"
printf '%s\n' '--- current customer contents ---'
sed -n '1,200p' "$root/live/customers.csv"
